summaryJa: FBIのFD-1057記録。2024年10月にFBIで匿名の被面談者が面談を受けた。被面談者は現職の雇用先と主な勤務施設を述べ、FBIへ既に提供されたプレゼンテーションと映像について言及した。2021年に自宅で午前約5時に最初のUAP目撃を経験し、単一の光が2–3つに分かれて中央に光のある三角形状を約10分間維持したと報告。スマートフォンで撮影中にフラッシュを誤って発し、光が消えたと述べた。2022年の別の目撃や、夕暮れや夜間に光が形を変えて側方に動く事例があると説明。LinkedIn経由で他者と連絡を取り「人々が傷つけられてきた」と警告された旨の会話や、1996年に車両が停止し強い光に照らされたという過去の出来事の申告も含まれる。被面談者は2021年から現住所に居住し、以前の居住地から合計で何百回もの光を観測し、複数の写真・動画を保有していると主張した。9月以降活動が増え、短時間の出現や録画が破損することが多いと述べた。目撃が航空機であるか検証するため、ADSBデータと日時・方位を照合して確認したと説明し、自身はUAPに元々関心があったわけではないと認めた。ケースIDは「Unidentified Aerial Phenomenon / Unidentified Anomalous Phenomenon」。
summaryEn: FBI FD-1057 electronic communication. In October 2024 an anonymized subject was interviewed at the FBI. The subject, employed at a named organization and working at a specific facility (redacted), discussed presentations and videos previously provided to the FBI. The subject reported a first UAP sighting in 2021 around 5 a.m. at home: a single light that split into two or three lights forming a triangular pattern with a center light, remaining for about ten minutes; the lights disappeared after an accidental flash photo. The subject referenced a separate March 2022 sighting and characterized sightings as typically at dusk or night with lights that morph and move laterally. The subject contacted another individual via LinkedIn who told them the observations were real and warned that “people have been hurt by these things,” and recounted a 1996 incident in New Mexico where a vehicle reportedly shut down and a large light illuminated occupants for about two minutes. The subject has lived at the current property since 2021 (previously ~5 miles away), claims to have observed hundreds of such lights and possesses numerous photos/videos willing to share; others have also observed them. Activity reportedly increased since September, with shorter bursts and frequent video corruption when recording. The subject used ADSB data to cross-check timestamps and azimuths to rule out aircraft and stated they were not previously interested in UAPs and that their statements may seem odd. Case ID notes Unidentified Aerial Phenomenon / Unidentified Anomalous Phenomenon.
